message: Expand acceptance after real CLI exposed context-usage JSON rendering regression

author: harness:codex

patch.value:
Implementation evidence (2026-08-07):
- Upgraded pm CLI/SDK and pm-changelog contracts to 2026.8.7; lock resolution is current and npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities after brace-expansion 5.0.9.
- Installed the canonical extension merge fence: generated extensions are non-mergeable while .managed-extensions.json retains pm-json semantic merging.
- A fresh npm-installed pm 2026.8.7 tracker exposed that context-usage --format json returned host-default TOON. The command now returns an owned rendered JSON payload; behavior-driven tests cover local --format json, global --json, filters, missing ledgers, affinity, and graceful SDK-affinity failure.
- Fresh acceptance at a disposable /tmp tracker installed this exact local extension, activated all three commands, packed a real item, parsed context-usage JSON, and passed strict check-only health with no warnings.
- Exact coverage: 195 tests passed; lines 100%, branches 100%, functions 100% across all three runtime source files.
- npm and Bun release gates, package dry-run, changelog check, dependency freshness, and npm production/full audits pass.
- Full vector health without --check-only is separately tracked upstream in pm-cli#928; the silent Ollama wait reproduced under a 45-second bound and fresh evidence was added without duplicating the issue.
- Publication remains maintainer-gated and was not attempted.
